overview_description.description:
Flaviar, a spirits tasting club, offers a subscription service that helps members discover new liquor products through sample tasting packs.

Subscribers are given access to rare and original spirits, invite them to great events, and keep them educated and entertained with booze-themed content and receive personalized samples and complimentary bottles every month.

Flaviar was established by Grisa Soba and Jugoslav Petkovic and was headquartered in London, England since 2012.

product.name: Flaviar Spirits Tasting Club Subscription
product.description: A subscription service delivering curated sample tasting packs of various spirits to members for exploration and discovery.

product.description: A paid membership providing special pricing, free shipping, priority access to limited releases, and exclusive spirits access.

product.name: The Vault
product.description: An exclusive collection of rare and exceptional spirits accessible only to Flaviar Black members.

product.name: Tasting Boxes
product.description: Curated themed boxes containing multiple 50ml spirit samples for flavor exploration before buying full bottles.

product.name: Online Marketplace for Spirits
product.description: An e-commerce platform selling a wide range of spirits including whiskey, rum, tequila, and more, with member-exclusive pricing and offers.

product.name: Flaviar Rewards Program
product.description: A loyalty program where customers earn points on purchases and actions, redeemable for rewards and discounts.
